headline: Path of Exile 2 1.0 December 11
title: Path of Exile 2 Full Release Date December 11 | Free to Play | Gaming News
video_script: Path of Exile two is leaving Early Access. Version one point zero launches on December eleventh on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series and PC. Early Access began on December sixth, twenty twenty four. The full launch adds the remaining campaign acts and a new class, the Duelist, and the game goes free to play. Which class will you pick? Comment below!
description: Path of Exile 2 version 1.0 launches December 11, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series and PC, leaving Early Access (started December 6, 2024) and going free to play. Sources: Gematsu, Push Square, Game Informer.
